findings.title: Frontend content is cached; admin edits take ~8s to appear
findings.detail: REVALIDATE_SECONDS=60 in portfolio-frontend/lib/api.js means the public site serves cached content for up to a minute. Not a defect, but it is not "real time" — measured ~8s in this run.

findings.title: No read/unread toggle on message detail
findings.detail: PUT /admin/messages/{id}/read exists but no control was found.
